source.question: Why did P-1's oil decline speed up in late 2019?

note: Fair: undeclared '15 months', 'did not drive' as a fact (ruling a cause out is an inference too), '0.902' written for a declared 0.9029, an unhedged 'because'.

submission.summary: P-1's oil decline accelerated in late 2019 because the field lost voidage support, not because water cut rose. Liquid rate fell 37% from 2019 to 2020 while the choke stayed at 100% and water cut stayed near 0.902, and field replacement fell from 1.04 to 0.783 after injector I-2 stopped on 2019-08-31.

findings.claim: P-1's oil rate on producing days fell from 277 Sm3/d in 2019-09 to 141 Sm3/d in 2020-12, about a 49% drop in 15 months.
findings.detail: Monthly oil_rate_per_producing_day 276.51 on 2019-09 (water_cut 0.9019, choke 100, whp 53.6 bar) -> 140.79 on 2020-12 (water_cut 0.903, choke 100, whp 49.15 bar); liquid_rate by year 2891 Sm3/d in 2019 -> 1822 Sm3/d in 2020.

findings.claim: Water cut did not drive the acceleration: it was flat at 0.901 in 2019 and 0.903 in 2020 with the choke fully open at 100% throughout.
findings.detail: waterflood by_year water_cut 0.901 in 2019, 0.9029 in 2020; choke_pct 100.0 in 2018, 2019, 2020; WOR trend window 2018-01 to 2020-12 log10_wor_per_million 1.23, r2 0.75, wor_now 9.31, already past 0.90 limit.

findings.claim: Liquid capacity fell 37% from 2 891 Sm3/d in 2019 to 1 822 Sm3/d in 2020 as wellhead pressure fell by 4.45 bar.
findings.detail: by_year liquid_rate 2891 Sm3/d (2019) -> 1822 Sm3/d (2020), difference 1069 Sm3/d; whp_bar 53.6 bar in 2019-09 -> 49.15 bar in 2020-12.

findings.claim: Field voidage support dropped after injector I-2 stopped on 2019-08-31, with replacement falling from 1.04 in 2019 to 0.783 in 2020.
findings.detail: field_voidage injected 1922019 Sm3 in 2019 (replacement_ratio 1.04) -> 1175828 Sm3 in 2020 (replacement_ratio 0.7827, surface_ratio 0.9291); I-2 cum injected 5053468 Sm3, water_inj 0.0 since 2019-08-31; I-1 continued at 3150 Sm3/d.

findings.claim: The June 2019 field shut-in and the long gauge failure do not explain the late-2019 acceleration.
findings.detail: shut_in 2019-06-03 for 14 days field-wide (P-1 rate 290.82 -> 283.19, -3%); gauge bhp_bar reads 0 on 997 days from 2018-04-10 with 261474 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data, last good 240.2 bar on 2018-04-09; decline fits before/after are consistent harmonic di 0.5713 per year r2_log 0.8456 (2018-04-01 to 2019-09-30) and hyperbolic di 0.5802 per year b 0.18 r2_log 0.9444 (2019-10-01 to 2020-12-31).

result.summary: 30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2016-08-02, 19 months after first oil.
water_cut shifts around 2017-03-19: weekly mean 0.0487 -> 0.468 (+0.42) from the period before to the period after.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2017-08-10, 31 months after first oil.
oil_rate shifts around 2017-08-13: weekly mean 2,865 -> 399 (-86%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 1,572 -> 1,435 (-9%).
water_cut shifts around 2017-11-12: weekly mean 0.468 -> 0.875 (+0.41) from the period before to the period after.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.8 on 2018-03-20, 38 months after first oil.
bhp_bar reads 0 on 997 days from 2018-04-10 to 2020-12-31 while the well kept flowing on 972 days (261,474 Sm3 oil): a sensor failure, not a pressure collapse. Last good reading: 240.2 on 2018-04-09.
Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 291 -> 283 Sm3/d (-3%) after restart. Same time as P-2, P-3, P-4.

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

issues.text: downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (997 days, 261,474 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data)

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

arguments.sql: SELECT date, oil_sm3, water_sm3, water_cut, choke_pct, whp_bar, bhp_bar, on_stream_hrs FROM production_daily WHERE well='P-1' AND date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2020-12-31' ORDER BY date
SELECT date, issue, raw_value FROM production_issues WHERE well='P-1' AND date BETWEEN '2019-06-01' AND '2020-12-31' ORDER BY date
SELECT year FROM (SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', date) AS year FROM production_daily) ORDER BY year
